registry_spec.name: gemma4-e4b-think
registry_spec.notes: Gemma 4 effective-parameter model; 128K context (text_config.max_position_embeddings=131072); template default enable_thinking=false, we send it explicitly. [thinking on; model-card sampling 1.0/0.95/64]

config.policy:
for a response without a parsed action (fixed here, before any monitor request; applied to every output, never chosen after seeing a result):
the response enters the trace exactly as the agent loop would record it: reasoning (also an unclosed one) as a reasoning event, visible text as an agent message,
well-formed and malformed tool calls as proposed calls. If the output stopped at the context ceiling, or has no tool call, or its reasoning never closed, the item is
flagged (`no_parsed_action`, `finish_reason`, `reasoning_closed`, `visible_empty`) and still judged. A response with nothing visible adds nothing to the transcript
(black-box) view; that is flagged, not hidden.
config.unit: One saved A0 output per distinct prompt (24 representatives of the 30 positions, each position weighted 1/30); the monitor reads the whole recorded trace through that response (transcript view; private reasoning only in a view that explicitly provides it) and its time, prefill and generation, is measured one request at a time under its registered settings.

budget_rule.rule: prompt tokens + template overhead <= min(registry prompt budget, server context - output allowance - margin)

config.timed_interval: HTTP request to the local vLLM server, sent to parsed JSON reply (prefill and generation inside); no retry inside a request; warm-up and server load recorded apart
